name: El Monte Rd pullout north side, short walk west of the river footbridge
basis: Mountain Project El Cajon Mountain 'Getting There': Lake Jennings Rd then east on El Monte Rd about 5.6 mi, park in the area on the north side of El Monte Rd (several telephone poles; past it is the El Capitan Reservoir gate); walk east a few hundred feet to a plank footbridge over the San Diego River, cross and follow the trail north; first trail leads to The Wedge (Main Wall), second to the Mountaineers Wall. The Wedge page repeats the north-side parking. Road check: lot is 0.01 km from El Monte Road (the neighbouring mapped lot w766535914 is 0.03 km, 60 m away; they are effectively the same pullout). Named-place check: San Diego River mapped at 32.8858,-116.8204, about 0.4 km east. Applied at the ECM level because the area page's own parking line covers it; Mountaineer Walls and the Wedge are 1.6-2.3 km from the lot.
